lines.text: @maya_front answers her phone on a crowded train, covers her other ear, and laughs at whatever she hears.

new_beats.text: The train lurches. @maya_front grabs the pole and keeps laughing.

writes.note: I added a beat where the train lurches and she keeps laughing, to show the call holds her.

reply.rationale: Kept her words and direction as they were and added one timed moment that gives the crowded train some motion without changing the action.
